title: A page opened in a space becomes its last page
statement: Whenever a page that belongs to a space is opened (DS02), remember it as that space's last page, and that space as the one last chosen.

title: A page opened shows in a tab
statement: Whenever a page is opened, open it in its space's tab group: activate its tab as it was, a plain open replacing the preview tab's page in place, and Back to a page whose tab was closed reopening it as the preview tab. When the address names views, the tab takes them and is kept.

title: The address follows the active tab
statement: Whenever the active tab changes (activated, cycled or a neighbor after a close), open its page with its views, so the address names the active tab.

title: An opened window gets its app server
statement: Whenever a product window opens, start the server it loads Lathe from, as SP02 decides.

title: A closed window's server stops
statement: Whenever a product window closes, or the shell quits (also when it is stopped from a terminal), stop the server the shell started for it.

title: An opened folder goes to the top of the recent folders
statement: Whenever a product window opens, add its folder to the recent folders, and to the system's recent documents.
